info.title: Parfumée API
info.description: API of the Parfumée shop. `/api/v1/shop` is used by the shop, `/api/v1/admin` by the back-office.

post.summary: Exchange a refresh token for a new session
post.description: A refresh token works once. The response carries a new one, which replaces it.

401.description: The refresh token is missing, unknown, expired or already used

post.description: Any account can sign in; the routes of the back-office then refuse an account without the editor or administrator role. Failed attempts are limited as on the shop, and the two sign-ins share the count.

get.summary: Read my identity and my roles

get.description: Requires the editor role. One page of the catalogue, sorted by name unless told otherwise. Every filter is optional.

schema.title: Exact value of the fragrance attribute.
Exact value of the size attribute.
Maximum number of products on a page.
Field to sort by. Products with the same value are then sorted by id, so that pages never overlap.

200.description: One page of the matching products

post.description: Requires the editor role. The slug is computed from the name.

put.description: Requires the editor role. The slug follows the name.

404.description: The product or the category does not exist

post.summary: Add a picture to a product
post.description: Requires the editor role. JPEG, PNG or WebP, 5 MB at most.

get.description: Requires the administrator role. One page of the accounts, sorted by email unless told otherwise.

schema.title: Part of the email, the first name or the last name, whatever the case.
Maximum number of accounts on a page.
Field to sort by. Accounts with the same value are then sorted by id, so that pages never overlap.

200.description: One page of the matching accounts

post.description: The refresh token can no longer be exchanged for a new session. The JWT already issued stays valid until it expires (15 minutes): a front forgets it. An unknown or already revoked refresh token is accepted too, so that signing out never fails.
The number of attempts from one address is limited, whatever their outcome.
Failed attempts are limited per email and per address; a successful sign-in clears the count of its email.

get.description: One page of the catalogue, sorted by name unless told otherwise. Every filter is optional.

schema.title: Exact value of the fragrance attribute.
Exact value of the size attribute.
Maximum number of products on a page.
Field to sort by. Products with the same value are then sorted by id, so that pages never overlap.

200.description: One page of the matching products

error.description: A message written for the client.

field.description: Name of the faulty field, as the client sent it.

fragrance.title: Exact value of the fragrance attribute.

size.title: Exact value of the size attribute.

per_page.title: Maximum number of products on a page.

sort.title: Field to sort by. Products with the same value are then sorted by id, so that pages never overlap.

q.title: Part of the email, the first name or the last name, whatever the case.

per_page.title: Maximum number of accounts on a page.

sort.title: Field to sort by. Accounts with the same value are then sorted by id, so that pages never overlap.

refresh_token.title: The refresh token of the session to end, as the sign-in or the last refresh returned it.

token.title: JWT to send in the Authorization header. It lasts 15 minutes.

refresh_token.title: Single-use value to exchange for a new session on /api/v1/token/refresh.

created_at.title: When the account was created, in UTC.

updated_at.title: When the account last changed, in UTC. A change of its addresses does not count.

url.title: Path of the file, relative to the uploads directory.

slug.title: URL-safe name, unique in the catalogue.

created_at.title: When the product was created, in UTC.

updated_at.title: When the product last changed, in UTC. Adding a picture does not change it.

per_page.title: Maximum number of items on a page.

total.title: Number of items matching the filters, over all pages.

total_pages.title: Number of pages, 0 when nothing matches. A page after the last one is empty, not an error.

BadRequest.description: The body is not valid JSON, or is not sent as `application/json`

Unauthorized.description: The token is missing, invalid or expired

Forbidden.description: The account does not have the required role

ValidationFailed.description: A field is missing or invalid

TooManyRequests.description: Too many attempts from this address. Wait for the number of seconds given by `Retry-After`.

TotalCount.description: Number of items matching the filters, over all pages. Same value as `pagination.total`.

RetryAfter.description: Number of seconds to wait before trying again.

Bearer.description: The `token` returned by a sign-in or a token refresh. It lasts 15 minutes.
